name: Runner (long hold)
description: A conviction hold for a large move: quarters at +100% and +200%, then the last half trails 40% off its peak. No hard stop, a 4-hour review, may carry a small remainder between agent sessions.

fit.summary: At least ~6 h old, liquidity >= $50k, top-10 <= 25% (or holder data unavailable with a stronger tape), a narrative heating up; or an upgrade from scalp/swing after TP1 filled.
signals: many distinct buyers, top-2 share low

hardStop.why: A runner has to survive the -20% to -45% shakeouts that come before most large moves. Rugs are handled by the thesis-break rules and by size.

reentry.requires: not in the same session; a later session runs a new full vet

notes: A downgrade (tighter exits) is allowed any time with a logged reason.

1.1.0 adds wake (the judgement calls that wake the position's agent session; noAnswer is what happens when no session answers in time) and maxHoldMinutes (a hard holding cap). Mechanical exits never wait for the session.
